goal: Publish an AWS-backed VII release where every important click acknowledges immediately and meaningful content remains visible until the next valid result is ready.

intent_model.literal_request: The site must fly: click, result, no blank white screen and no heavy loading. Plan with experts and implement it.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A consistently fast-feeling public discovery product across navigation, search, live sliders, images and maps, not a cosmetic loader on one page.
likely_rejections: A previous result disappears while a tab or query refreshes
Only the homepage is optimized while another discovery route remains slow
A speed change damages image quality, galleries, accessibility or live availability truth
The public domain is not the exact tested AWS-backed build

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Acknowledge input locally within one frame and preserve useful content until atomic replacement.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Measure immediate feedback and inspect every changed loading transition.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Cover the shared public discovery family, not only one reported slider.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Test representative route families, languages and viewport states.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Code, verify, publish and recheck at the natural destination under the already authorized AWS release.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Local success is insufficient without live AWS provenance and rollback evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: A click must feel accepted immediately and the prior useful state must not disappear.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Use last-good content with atomic replacement, deferred heavy modules and fixed media geometry.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Verify the candidate and publish only after every release gate passes.
deferred_complexity: Long-term RUM dashboards and deeper framework migration can follow after the verified cutover.

natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co on the exact AWS-backed release

facts.claim: Home live deals and spa deals currently clear valid data when starting some refreshes.
facts.evidence: Pre-change source audit of app/components/home-live-deals.tsx and app/components/spa-package-deals.tsx

facts.claim: Leaflet is dynamically deferred but the map component serializes the full incoming places collection during render.
facts.evidence: Pre-change source audit of app/components/listing-map.tsx and app/components/deferred-listing-map.tsx

facts.claim: The authoritative VII plan and feedback standards apply to this public release.

assumptions.claim: The exact Sites-managed source can accept the final AWS environment secret through an authorized secure path.
assumptions.validation: Verify the environment setting without printing the secret, deploy, then require public AWS provenance.

assumptions.claim: Representative lab timings are meaningful enough for this release in the absence of current field RUM percentiles.
assumptions.validation: Measure repeated cold and warm runs and mark field percentile claims unavailable rather than inventing them.

in_scope: Preserve last-good live results during refresh and recover without an empty region
Immediate local navigation and search feedback without a full-page white overlay
Avoid full result serialization and keep Leaflet deferred until map intent
Reserve shared card image geometry without recompressing or replacing verified media
Focused, full, desktop, mobile, failure, retry, reload, back and language verification
AWS-backed deployment, public cutover, post-deploy checks and rollback retention
out_of_scope: Claiming field Core Web Vitals without field data
invariants: Final booking and availability actions revalidate fresh supplier state
Existing galleries, map controls, localization and approved copy remain available
Verified source media is not recompressed, replaced or mislabeled
Current public release remains a rollback until final verification passes
No secret appears in source, logs, screenshots or evidence
affected_family: Hebrew, English, Russian and French routes
AWS production candidate and public release

requirements.statement: A changed asynchronous discovery action keeps meaningful prior content visible and acknowledges the click within 100 ms.
Heavy map and media work does not block ordinary list navigation or cause avoidable layout shift.
The complete change passes shared-family regression and public desktop/mobile verification.
The final public domain runs the immutable tested release with AWS database provenance and retained rollback.
Refreshing the page, navigating back and retrying a failure preserve or recover the correct visible state.

acceptance_checks.setup: A live slider has valid visible cards and the next response is delayed.
acceptance_checks.action: Choose another valid tab or audience.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The control changes immediately, aria-busy becomes true, prior cards remain visible but non-interactive, and the new validated result replaces them atomically.

acceptance_checks.setup: Valid cards are visible and the refresh request fails.
acceptance_checks.action: Trigger a refresh and then retry.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The existing cards never disappear, a concise local error and retry appear, and successful retry replaces the result.

acceptance_checks.setup: A result list with 100 or more projected map places is visible.
acceptance_checks.action: Use the list, then focus or click the map control.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Leaflet is absent from list-only startup, begins on intent, no full incoming-record JSON serialization occurs and the map acknowledges opening within 300 ms.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative cards load on desktop and 390-pixel mobile.
acceptance_checks.action: Cold load, scroll and change gallery images.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Card media geometry is reserved, verified crops and galleries remain intact, and lab CLS is at most 0.05 on tested critical routes.

acceptance_checks.setup: The exact release candidate is available.
acceptance_checks.action: Run focused and full tests plus home, search, spa, events, holiday and business flows in desktop and mobile viewports.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No critical or high regression, no blank content transition and all applicable routes remain usable in Hebrew and representative LTR language.

acceptance_checks.setup: The immutable candidate and prior public release are identified.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish and inspect the public domain.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The domain serves the exact candidate with AWS origin and Aurora evidence; the previous release remains restorable until post-deploy checks pass.

acceptance_checks.setup: A search or live-result selection is active.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload, navigate away and back, and cross the mobile breakpoint.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: URL-backed state, visible results and scroll or viewport locks recover consistently without a duplicate blank fetch.

acceptance_checks.action: Use the visible retry control after service recovery.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: One bounded retry returns the component to a valid ready state without duplicate side effects.

open_questions.question: Which lab timing percentiles are reproducible on the final host?
open_questions.resolution: Measure the exact candidate and report the observed values; do not claim unavailable field percentiles.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests and public AWS release are authorized. Secret values must remain protected; any interactive transfer that requires a separate safety confirmation must be confirmed at the moment of action.
